# IVD degeneration partial fabrication variant B

Disc matrix and structural gene expression in NP cells showed degeneration-related changes. FOXF1 was upregulated (Table 4). PAX1 was downregulated in degenerated NP (Table 4). KRT18 was upregulated (Table 4). SOX9 was downregulated (Table 4). ACAN was upregulated (Table 4). COL2A1 was downregulated (Table 4). MMP13 was upregulated (Table 4). TNF was downregulated (Table 4). IL6 was upregulated (Table 4).
